note: Apache Velocity 1.7 (spring-boot-starter-velocity, a VM_global_library.vm macro library, #parse/#include of module/*.vm) on Spring Boot 1.4.1 / Spring 4.3.3, below Thwart's Boot 1.5 floor (Spring 4.3 is supported): a migration may need to bump Boot to 1.5 first. No spring-boot-maven-plugin (thin jar plus lib/), so start.sh runs it from target/classes and the Maven classpath, on H2 in MySQL mode instead of MySQL. Velocity escapes nothing; post and resume bodies are stored HTML. Apache-2.0.
